articles.title: Malaysia starts sending Myanmar migrants home
articles.summary: Dozens of buses arrived under police escort at the Majlis Perbandaran Manjung stadium near the Lumut naval base in northwestern Malaysia. The migrants were expected to be processed before being taken to Myanmar by ship. Malaysia starts sending Myanmar migrants home.

Tran Hiep, a 50-year-old Vietnamese Australian anti-human trafficking campaigner, not heard from since 18 SeptemberVietnamese authorities have detained three activists, including an Australian, on what have been described as “fabricated” charges. An office building in Dnipro and an apartment block in Kharkiv also suffered damage. The attacks caused casualties and disrupted services. A wave of Russian attacks hit civilian sites in several Ukrainian cities on September 28. In Kyiv, fire broke out after strikes on the National Academy of Sciences and a major medical clinic.

articles.title: UN leaders renew push to defeat racism, 25 years after Durban
articles.summary: “No country is free of racism.” That warning from US youth activist Marley Dias set the tone on Monday as UN Member States reinvigorated global efforts against racism, discrimination and xenophobia with a new declaration. UN leaders renew push to defeat racism, 25 years after Durban.

articles.title: DPR Korea tells UN its nuclear status is ‘irreversible’, rejects outside pressure
articles.summary: The Democratic People’s Republic of Korea (DPRK) told the UN General Assembly on Monday that its status as a nuclear-armed State was irreversible, arguing that its military capabilities were necessary to safeguard the country’s sovereignty and maintain peace on the Korean Peninsula. DPR Korea tells UN its nuclear status is ‘irreversible’, rejects outside pressure.

articles.title: Refugee funding, US migration policy triggers ‘cascade’ of rights violations, world forests report

articles.title: Ambassadors meet as West Bank tensions rise, Gaza plan stalls
articles.summary: The Security Council met Monday morning with prospects for peace in the Middle East under strain on two fronts. In the West Bank, settler violence and settlement expansion are raising fears for a two-State solution. In Gaza, a year-old peace plan has stalled while civilian suffering continues. The meeting comes as the plan’s remaining phases, including Hamas’ disarmament and Israel’s full withdraw.

articles.title: World leaders take stock of global fight against racism
articles.summary: World leaders are meeting in the General Assembly to assess how far the world has come in combating racism and how far it still has to go. The Durban Declaration and Programme of Action, the most comprehensive framework of its kind, seeks to acknowledge historical injustices, dismantle inequalities and build societies grounded in dignity, equality and justice for all. World leaders take stock of global fight against racism.

articles.title: DR Congo Ebola emergency: Calls grow for urgent humanitarian access
articles.summary: Aid teams trying to keep deadly Ebola disease from spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) are increasingly concerned about ongoing fighting and violence that has forced thousands of people to flee a displacement camp in the vast, resource-rich east of the country. DR Congo Ebola emergency: Calls grow for urgent humanitarian access.

articles.title: Canada urges stronger partnerships as global order faces ‘rupture’

Canada urges stronger partnerships as global order faces ‘rupture’.

articles.title: दिल्ली से पटना और मुंबई तक बारिश होगी या निकलेगी धूप? जानें IMD का अलर्ट
articles.summary: देश के कई हिस्सों में एक बार फिर मौसम बदलने वाला है. भारत मौसम विज्ञान विभाग (IMD) के अनुसार 29 सितंबर को कई राज्यों में बारिश, गरज-चमक और तेज हवाओं का दौर जारी रह सकता है. पहाड़ी राज्यों में बारिश के साथ भूस्खलन और दूसरे मौसम से जुड़े खतरे भी बने रह सकते हैं. अंडमान सागर के उत्तरी हिस्से में 29 सितंबर को मौसम खराब रह सकता है.
